cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.4)
project(current_sdk_awisp C CXX)
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
set(SUNXI_MPP_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "Exported current SDK MPP bundle")
set(SUNXI_MPP_SOURCE_ROOT "" CACHE PATH "SDK middleware/sun8iw21 source root")
set(AWISP_LIBRARY_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Directory of current SDK ISP archives")
set(AWISP_SYSTEM_LIBRARY_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Directory of glog/unwind DSOs")
if(SUNXI_MPP_ROOT)
 set(MPP_HEADERS "${SUNXI_MPP_ROOT}/include/mpp/middleware")
 set(AWISP_LIBRARY_DIR "${SUNXI_MPP_ROOT}/lib")
else()
 set(MPP_HEADERS "${SUNXI_MPP_SOURCE_ROOT}")
endif()
if(NOT AWISP_SYSTEM_LIBRARY_DIR)
 set(AWISP_SYSTEM_LIBRARY_DIR "${AWISP_LIBRARY_DIR}")
endif()
set(ISP_HEADERS "${MPP_HEADERS}/media/LIBRARY/libisp")
if(NOT EXISTS "${ISP_HEADERS}/isp.h")
 message(FATAL_ERROR "Current sun8iw21/ISP600 headers missing; set SUNXI_MPP_ROOT or SUNXI_MPP_SOURCE_ROOT")
endif()
set(ISP_ARCHIVES libISP.a libisp_dev.a libisp_ini.a libiniparser.a libisp_ae.a libisp_af.a libisp_afs.a libisp_awb.a libisp_base.a libisp_gtm.a libisp_iso.a libisp_math.a libisp_md.a libisp_pltm.a libisp_rolloff.a libion.a liblog.a libmedia_utils.a)
set(ISP_LIBRARIES)
foreach(n IN LISTS ISP_ARCHIVES)
 if(NOT EXISTS "${AWISP_LIBRARY_DIR}/${n}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Build matching eyesee-mpp first: ${AWISP_LIBRARY_DIR}/${n}")
 endif()
 list(APPEND ISP_LIBRARIES "${AWISP_LIBRARY_DIR}/${n}")
endforeach()
add_library(AWIspApi SHARED AWIspApi.c)
set_target_properties(AWIspApi PROPERTIES SOVERSION 1 VERSION 1.0.0 LINKER_LANGUAGE CXX)
target_compile_definitions(AWIspApi PRIVATE AWCHIP=0x1886)
target_include_directories(AWIspApi PRIVATE
 "${MPP_HEADERS}/include" "${MPP_HEADERS}/include/media" "${MPP_HEADERS}/include/utils"
 "${MPP_HEADERS}/media/include" "${MPP_HEADERS}/media/include/utils"
 "${ISP_HEADERS}" "${ISP_HEADERS}/include" "${ISP_HEADERS}/include/device"
 "${ISP_HEADERS}/include/V4l2Camera" "${ISP_HEADERS}/isp_dev" "${ISP_HEADERS}/isp_tuning")
target_link_libraries(AWIspApi PRIVATE
 "-Wl,--start-group" ${ISP_LIBRARIES} "-Wl,--end-group"
 "${AWISP_SYSTEM_LIBRARY_DIR}/libglog.so" "${AWISP_SYSTEM_LIBRARY_DIR}/libunwind.so"
 Threads::Threads dl m)
set_property(TARGET AWIspApi APPEND_STRING PROPERTY LINK_FLAGS " -Wl,--no-undefined")
install(TARGETS AWIspApi LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES AWIspApi.h DESTINATION include)
install(DIRECTORY "${ISP_HEADERS}/" DESTINATION include/sunxi-isp FILES_MATCHING PATTERN "*.h")
